column1: # THE DAMAGE SHAPES a handed-over Elixir corpus ebin is held against (F-217,
# TestElixirEbinHandoffDamageCorpus). The rig compiles nothing: two shards are
# given from stand-in ebins (s1: unit u1, A.beam "alpha-beam"; s2: unit u2,
# B.beam "beta-beam"; each also holds the driver's D.beam, whose bytes differ
# by shard as a real driver's do by checkout path), one row's damage is
# applied, and the shards are taken into one ebin. A row with expect "ok" must
# give exactly A.beam, B.beam and s1's D.beam; every other row must be refused
# with its expect text in the message, leave no ebin, and compile nothing.
# file is relative to the rig: from/<shard>/... is a handed-over shard,
# tree/... is the job's own checkout, "-" is none.
